originality.rationale: The 2023 article conjectures the Markovian mean scale and proves only the state-cover \(r=s\) case; its Gumbel theorem is for independent block draws. Fixed-\(r\) Markovian shadow theorems give no uniform limit as \(r_n\to\infty\), and a dense-block \(r_n=n-k\) result concerns a disjoint regime. The new contribution proves a uniform \(r_n\log n=o(n)\) killed-eigenvalue estimate and Poisson/Gumbel completion profile. Unindexed broader cover-time theorems remain a documented risk.
